offering_description.value: Sotera Health sterilizes products and provides laboratory testing and advisory services for medical device, pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers. It operates sterilization facilities and testing laboratories and supplies cobalt-60 sources and irradiation equipment to sterilization operators.

primary_products.value: Cobalt-60 radiation sources; gamma irradiation systems

primary_services.value: Contract sterilization; microbiological testing; analytical chemistry testing; sterilization validation; technical and regulatory consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Medical device, pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers, contract sterilization operators and irradiation facility operators

end_markets.value: Medical devices; pharmaceuticals and biotechnology; contract sterilization; food irradiation

revenue_model.value: service fees: Sterilization of customer products, laboratory testing, validation and technical consulting; product sales: Cobalt-60 radiation sources and gamma irradiation systems

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Sterilizes customer products and tests samples for medical device, pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturers; asset operator: Runs sterilization facilities and laboratories that process products and samples for manufacturers; component supplier: Processes reactor-produced cobalt-60 into sealed radiation sources for irradiation facility operators; OEM / manufacturer: Builds gamma irradiation systems for sterilization and other irradiation facility operators
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; component supplier; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Contract sterilization, laboratory testing and advisory services, cobalt-60 sources and gamma irradiation systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Commercial teams contract with manufacturers and sell radiation sources and equipment to irradiation operators; own locations: Company-operated sterilization facilities and laboratories receive customer products and test samples

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Radioactive source handling requires nuclear licenses, and ethylene oxide sterilization is subject to EPA emissions rules
